metadata.locale_mode: automatic detection; do not force a locale
metadata.description: A draft paired en-US/en-GB anchor with ten newly composed passages, explicit dialect cues, and one predefined negative control per passage.
metadata.passage_origin: New draft composed for this protocol; no text from the former H-suite candidate was intentionally reused. Similarity and rights review remain open.

data_license.scope: Original passages, annotations, and controls in this manifest only; not code, provider outputs, or third-party material.

scoring.control_matching: case-insensitive exact phrase with word boundaries

weekly_challenge.comparison_rule: Compare engines on the same week's challenge set; use only the fixed anchor for week-to-week trend comparisons.

external_spelling_panel.scoring_role: separate spelling diagnostic; not part of the four-pillar composite

inputs.en-US: Yo, that basement show went hard; my frend dropped the setlist beside the merch table. We packed orange cables as the last train rolled in, and the hall were still warm after midnight. I ain't forgetting the chorus. A bright color tag marked my case.

negative_control.why_wrong: Changing 'last' to 'first' reverses which train arrived.
